subject.title: Modular Dashboard: agent-composable Control UI workspaces (tracking)

question: Should OpenClaw accept this modular dashboard workspace stack as a bundled Control UI product direction, and under what storage and custom-widget security boundaries?
rationale: The request adds a new default-facing dashboard model, persistent workspace state, Gateway RPC/event surfaces, agent tools, and untrusted browser widget execution; code inspection alone cannot choose that product/security boundary.

options.title: Review and sponsor the stack
options.body: Proceed through the three linked PRs in order, requiring storage-policy, security-boundary, upgrade, and proof concerns to be resolved before merge.

options.title: Narrow to reusable seams
options.body: Land only generic plugin/API gaps maintainers want and ask dashboard-specific workspaces or widgets to remain plugin/ClawHub-owned until sponsored.

options.title: Defer the direction
options.body: Keep or close the PR stack based on maintainer roadmap judgment if bundled dashboard composition is not current product work.

recommendation.title: Review and sponsor the stack
recommendation.body: Proceed through the three linked PRs in order, requiring storage-policy, security-boundary, upgrade, and proof concerns to be resolved before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest recent owner signal for both the Control UI direction and plugin-tab seam this proposal reuses.
